tasks.label: Exercise 3.13 · Q3
tasks.question: 3. If the roots of (a − b)x² + (b − c)x + (c − a) = 0 are real and equal, then prove that b, a, c are in arithmetic progression.
tasks.answer: Hence proved: b, a, c are in arithmetic progression.
tasks.sourceReference: TN SCERT Standard Ten Mathematics revised 2025, English, Exercise 3.13 Q3; printed p. 119, PDF p. 125; source image checked (proof question; no Appendix entry).

tasks.label: Exercise 3.13 · Q4
tasks.question: 4. If a, b are real then show that the roots of the equation (a − b)x² − 6(a + b)x − 9(a − b) = 0 are real and unequal.
tasks.answer: Hence proved: the roots are real and unequal.
tasks.sourceReference: TN SCERT Standard Ten Mathematics revised 2025, English, Exercise 3.13 Q4; printed p. 119, PDF p. 125; source image checked (proof question; no Appendix entry).

tasks.label: Exercise 3.13 · Q5
tasks.question: 5. If the roots of the equation (c² − ab)x² − 2(a² − bc)x + b² − ac = 0 are real and equal prove that either a = 0 (or) a³ + b³ + c³ = 3abc
tasks.answer: Hence proved: either a = 0 or a³ + b³ + c³ = 3abc.
tasks.sourceReference: TN SCERT Standard Ten Mathematics revised 2025, English, Exercise 3.13 Q5; printed p. 119, PDF p. 125; source image checked (proof question; no Appendix entry).
